meta.title: 5 Things You Must Do in Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon Travel Guide)
meta.description:
Ho Chi Minh City, still known to many as Saigon, is Vietnam’s largest and most dynamic city. In this video we explore five things you must do when visiting Ho Chi Minh City, from historic war sites to modern skyscrapers and one of the most famous nightlife streets in Southeast Asia.

Whether you are visiting for a few days or planning a longer trip through Vietnam, these must-do experiences will give you a great introduction to the culture, history, and energy of this incredible city. From the powerful exhibits inside the War Remnants Museum to the famous Ben Thanh Market, the skyline views from Bitexco Tower and Landmark 81, the lively nightlife of Bui Vien Walking Street, and the historic Cu Chi Tunnels just outside the city, these are some of the most memorable things to experience in Saigon.

If you're planning a trip to Vietnam, Ho Chi Minh City is a destination that blends history, modern development, and an unforgettable atmosphere.
